sections.title: Synopsis
sections.markdown: Cornerstone support of the hydro element - boosts allies' maximum health through health overflow and enhances Confectance Index generation (V1+). Enhances team survivability through health overflow and continuous, passive healing. Offensive utility is mostly exclusive to the hydro element.

sections.title: Team notes
sections.markdown: Springfield enables the hydro DPS crew through her unique mechanics of health overflow and Shared Telepathy (V1+) and her other offensive utility is specific to the hydro element, so mono-hydro teams are recommended. However, she can flex in with 1-2 hydro DPS into mixed teams well - she can implant hydro weakness for the DPS while providing generic survivability utility to the whole team.

sections.title: Build notes
sections.markdown: The summons Taryz and Elsin do damage based on Springfield's maximum health and their damage shares dwarf Springfield's, so building for health + critical rate/damage is recommended. Regarding damage modifier priority, it will depend on Springfield's fortification level. At lower levels, Elsin's damage share is higher so physical summon modifiers are more effective. But at higher levels, Taryz, who uses Springfield's modifiers, will have a much higher damage share. In that case, hydro modifiers is more recommended.
